CustomField.description: Google Maps link built from Check In Geo.
CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK("https://www.google.es/maps/dir/" & IF(ISBLANK(Check_In_Geo_c__Latitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_In_Geo_c__Latitude__s)) & "," & IF(ISBLANK(Check_In_Geo_c__Longitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_In_Geo_c__Longitude__s)) & "/" & IF(ISBLANK(Check_In_Geo_c__Latitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_In_Geo_c__Latitude__s)) & "," & IF(ISBLANK(Check_In_Geo_c__Longitude__s), "0", TEXT(Check_In_Geo_c__Longitude__s)), "Click On This URL")
CustomField.label: Check In Location
